00052 #define DLL_CALLCONV __stdcall
00053 // The following ifdef block is the standard way of creating macros which make exporting 
00054 // from a DLL simpler. All files within this DLL are compiled with the FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00055 // symbol defined on the command line. this symbol should not be defined on any project
00056 // that uses this DLL. This way any other project whose source files include this file see 
00057 // DLL_API functions as being imported from a DLL, wheras this DLL sees symbols
00058 // defined with this macro as being exported.
00059 #ifdef FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00060 #define DLL_API __declspec(dllexport)
00061 #else
00062 #define DLL_API __declspec(dllimport)
00063 #endif // FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00064 #endif // FREEIMAGE_LIB || !WIN32

00284 FI_STRUCT(FreeImageIO) {

00286     FI_WriteProc write_proc;    // pointer to the function used to write data
00287     FI_SeekProc  seek_proc;     // pointer to the function used to seek
00288     FI_TellProc  tell_proc;     // pointer to the function used to aquire the current position
00289 };
